exposure: Mode of delivery (planned vs unplanned cesarean)
outcome: Incidence of skin-to-skin contact during cesarean birth
cohort: 2,327 women who had a cesarean birth within the last 10 years prior to January 2022
finding: Significant associations were found between skin-to-skin contact during cesarean birth and planned cesarean birth, previous cesarean birth, maternal age, level of education, and birth region.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean birth and previous cesarean birth were significantly associated with higher rates of skin-to-skin contact during cesarean birth.
